`interface IFontFace`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`MsdfFontFace`](/reference/text/msdffontface/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.glyph` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IFontFace.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/glyph/IFontFace.java)

One face of a glyph font, a weight and a style, with its metrics on 1 of the font size.

## Description

[`MsdfFontFace`](/reference/text/msdffontface/) implements it; implement it with your own [`GlyphTextRenderer`](/reference/text/glyphtextrenderer/) for another kind of glyph font.
Every metric is on 1 of the font size: a line height of `1.2F` at a size of 20 design pixels is 24 design pixels.

- [Fonts](/use/learn/going-further/fonts/)
